card.name: Partway through capitalized names and acronyms
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a capitalized proper name or acronym, such as the 'ada' in Sec-ada, 'ra' in C-ra-ik, or 'RA' in INC-RA. Most often in citation lists and reference entries.

modes.label: Surnames in citations
modes.description: A piece inside an author surname after a capital letter in a reference list.

modes.label: Acronym endings
modes.description: The closing letters of an agency or technical acronym like INCRA or SCSI.
